entries.title: Psalms 145:14
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: All - All that look up to him for help.

entries.title: Psalms 145:15
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: All - Of all living creatures. Wait - Expect their supplies wholly from thy bounty. Expectation is here figuratively ascribed to brute creatures.

entries.title: Psalms 145:18
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Nigh - To answer their prayers. In truth - With an upright heart.
